title: God's Eye View: a spy satellite in your browser
notes: Facts checked 2026-10-11. github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view (by Bilawal Sidhu and Sameh Khamis, Halfpixel; site maptheworld.ai; formerly WorldView): 50.9k stars, 10.3k forks, MIT; tagline 'A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real.'; '#1 on GitHub Trending, daily and weekly · August 2026'; layers: live flights 11,000+ aircraft (OpenSky, adsb.lol), military flights (adsb.lol), live vessels (AISStream, free key), satellites 838-object catalog (CelesTrak, SGP4), earthquakes last 24h (USGS), traffic simulated on OSM roads, CCTV ~3,900 public DOT/city cameras (Austin, Texas, California, London, Ontario, Finland...), active fires (NASA FIRMS, free key), rain radar, satellite clouds, lightning (NOAA nowCOAST), cyclones (NOAA NHC), wind (GFS/ECMWF); 17 of 20 layers have a keyless path; sensor styles CRT, NVG, FLIR/thermal, Noir, Snow; CesiumJS, Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles (Cesium ion free personal non-commercial; Google direct metered); voice via OpenAI Realtime API (metered key); runs locally: git clone, npm ci, npm run dev; disclaimer: data 'may be delayed, incomplete, modeled, inferred, or wrong', not for navigation or emergency response; traffic simulated, CCTV poses estimates; 'does not build features for named-person search, face recognition, or tracking individuals'.
